episode_id: Catch up with upstream without losing what either side added, or reviving what either side removed. Start from upstream's dependency file and add back what I added./seed-5-lockfile_conflict-10027

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 1 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 2 resolves to 'keep_local', which accepts ['keep_local'], but the program implements 'take_upstream'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.body:
set -eu

fetch_remote="{upstream_remote}"
upstream_ref="{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}"

git fetch "$fetch_remote"

merge_base="$(git merge-base HEAD "$upstream_ref")"

shared_lockfiles="$(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$merge_base" HEAD -- | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -E '(^|/)[^/]*\.lock$' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$merge_base" "$upstream_ref" -- | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -E '(^|/)[^/]*\.lock$' | sort))"

if [ -z "$shared_lockfiles" ]; then
  echo "no shared lockfile found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

resolve_lockfile() {
  path="$1"
  merge_base="$2"

  base_file="$(mktemp)"
  local_file="$(mktemp)"
  upstream_file="$(mktemp)"
  added_file="$(mktemp)"
  trap 'rm -f "$base_file" "$local_file" "$upstream_file" "$added_file"' RETURN

  git show ":1:$path" > "$base_file" 2>/dev/null || git show "$merge_base:$path" > "$base_file"
  git show ":2:$path" > "$local_file" 2>/dev/null || git show "HEAD:$path" > "$local_file"
  git show ":3:$path" > "$upstream_file" 2>/dev/null || git show "$upstream_ref:$path" > "$upstream_file"

  git diff --no-index --unified=0 "$base_file" "$local_file" \
    | awk '/^@@/ { pure=0; if (match($0, /^@@ -[0-9]+,0 \+/)) pure=1; next }
           pure && /^\+[^+]/ { print substr($0,2) }' \
    | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*".*",?[[:space:]]*$' > "$added_file" || true

  insert_ln="$(awk -v base_file="$base_file" '
    BEGIN { while ((getline line < base_file) > 0) base[line]=1 }
    /^packages = \[/ { in_pkgs=1; next }
    in_pkgs && /^\]/ { exit }
    in_pkgs && base[$0] { print NR; exit }
  ' "$upstream_file")"

  if [ -z "$insert_ln" ]; then
    insert_ln="$(awk '
      /^packages = \[/ { in_pkgs=1; next }
      in_pkgs && /^\]/ { print NR; exit }
    ' "$upstream_file")"
  fi

  if [ -z "$insert_ln" ]; then
    echo "could not find packages block in $path" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  awk -v insert_ln="$insert_ln" -v added_file="$added_file" -v upstream_file="$upstream_file" '
    BEGIN {
      while ((getline line < upstream_file) > 0) seen[line]=1
      while ((getline line < added_file) > 0) { n++; add[n]=line }
    }
    NR == insert_ln {
      for (i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        line=add[i]
        if (line != "" && !(line in seen)) {
          print line
          seen[line]=1
        }
      }
    }
    { print; seen[$0]=1 }
  ' "$upstream_file" > "$path"

  git add -- "$path"

  rm -f "$base_file" "$local_file" "$upstream_file" "$added_file"
  trap - RETURN
}

if ! git merge "$upstream_ref" --no-edit; then
  while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
    case "$path" in
      *.lock) : ;;
      *) echo "unexpected conflict: $path" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac

    resolve_lockfile "$path" "$merge_base"
  done < <(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z)

  if git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z | grep -q .; then
    echo "unresolved conflicts remain" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  git add --all
  git commit --no-edit
fi
